rv.q: “Why are you so afraid of adults?” she asks, deadpan. Age-inappropriate danger lurks everywhere: The group will soon be commiserating with their friend Sophie (Sophie Rossman), who has been sexually menaced by a creep who turns out to be her father’s work buddy.
Smith is touching on a cold and bracing thing. Sometimes, people, like pixels, can just flicker out.

Loren Noveck Renée-Nicole Powell, Sophie Rossman, Kayta Thomas, and Amalia Yoo in Dad Don't Read This . As I watched Dad, Don’t Read This, I had a spiral of cringe and gratitude running through my brain: Cringe at the raw shock of recognition of awkward feelings and memories I thought I’d left behind in my own long-ago adolescence.
